decision: Accept byte-identical observations from two fresh frozen-original processes and the retained v0.28 installed adapter before implementing complete request dispatch. Forwarding observers preserve actual decisions. No comparison projection or expected-result regeneration is used.
scope: 88 courses and 104 transitions through the complete post-preflight request path. Seeded states and synthetic definitions are explicit; native targeting, lightweight promotion, toggles, costs and cast preparation execute original methods.

sourceBoundary.retainedIncludes: Existing preflight, ammunition commitment and duration helper delegation must remain in use.

correctionsBeforeAcceptance: The first vent endpoint test assumed actor admission used World time. Source and execution show that actor admission refuses any positive vent stamp until the sweep clears it. Active-aura release separately reaches the World time comparison, where equality is admitted. Both paths are preserved.
The setup pool initially named a nonexistent ice_lance entry; it now asserts registry membership and uses the original frostbolt definition. No runtime was changed.

Native Seize has no innate targeting spec. The request-time promotion branch is exercised by an explicitly labelled Seize variant with targeting; the lightweight body and promotion operation remain native.
A capture helper type-check required an always-present assertion message; no observation or game behavior changed.
limitations: Forwarding observers record meaningful call order, state at callbacks and complete random draw sequences. They do not replace game decisions.
Per-run identity tokens record skill-instance relationships; selected actor identities, resources, cast records and downstream effects are retained. Non-finite numbers use explicit tags.
Definition combinations, attributes, banks, statuses, construct flags and held states are seeded and labelled. This is not proof of every authored content combination.
Spatial queries, effect delivery and ongoing casting updates remain host capabilities. The dispatcher orchestrates those ports; their mechanics are not all extracted by this boundary.
No renderer, physical input, performance, allocation, hardware or native-engine installation claim is established by these captures.
